treaty_name: Convention between the Government of the Republic of Malta and the Government of the Republic of Azerbaijan for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income (2016)
eif_quote: (c) that the Convention has entered into force on the 27th December, 2016. | Art. 28(2): "The Convention shall be applicable in respect of taxes on income derived during any calendar year or accounting period, as the case may be, beginning on or after the first day of January immediately following the date on which the Convention enters into force."
source_title: S.L. 123.169 Double Taxation Relief (Taxes on Income) (The Republic of Azerbaijan) Order (L.N. 214 of 2016), legislation.mt

rates.quote: (a) where the dividends are paid by a company which is a resident of Azerbaijan to a resident of Malta who is the beneficial owner thereof, the tax so charged in Azerbaijan shall not exceed 8 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends;

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 8 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 8 per cent of the gross amount of royalties.

ppt.quote: [MT MLI] Pursuant to Article 7(17)(b) of the Convention, Malta hereby chooses to apply Article 7(4). (no Art. 7 reservation; 'AZERBAIJAN Original 29-04-2016 27-12-2016' listed); [AZ MLI] no Art. 7 reservation; Malta listed.

notes: Dividends are asymmetric: Azerbaijan-source dividends capped at 8% (source_state AZ); Malta-source dividends (Art. 10(2)(b)): "Malta tax on the gross amount of the dividends shall not exceed that chargeable on the profits out of which the dividends are paid" — no fixed percentage cap, so no MT-source dividend entry (Protocol ad Art. 10 defines gross amount for Malta as grossed-up dividend). Interest exempt at source (Art. 11(3)) where payer/recipient is a Government, administrative-territorial subdivision, local authority or Central Bank, or recipient is a wholly government-owned financial institution — not modelled. Treaty Art. 28(2) applies the Convention to income derived in calendar years/accounting periods beginning on or after 1 Jan 2017. MLI Art. 8 not applicable (Azerbaijan reserved). Legal Notice 115 of 2018 referenced in the order heading not reviewed (not shown in consolidated text; rates text unaffected as consolidated).
